I stumbled on this post because I have to write a posting tomorrow about Blog Security. Looking at some reactions, I think some kids read this blog also. I'm a sytem engineer who was involved in building the Interenet. In the early nineties I learned to know Hacktic (http://www.hacktic.nl/). These guys were socialy engaged and reacted against the allmightyness of computers as it was put then. Now these guys are system Engineers, work at RIPE etc... but they still meet regularly see:
http://har2009.org/index.php?p=86 and also my statement about hacking http://home.deds.nl/~danielverhoeven/hacking.html

Now about cyberwars. It's an allusion to think that assymetries you find in society, in diplomacy, in warfare are not reflected on the Net. There are more cyberwars ongoing then one can imagine. e.g. the Chinese are very active hacking US military sites.
